notes:
Pass on the fake backend (gate exit 0; G1-G5, G7 and G9 pass, G6 and G8 warn only). Evidence is contract_checked on the package's fake only; no upstream simulator, ROS graph, PX4/Gazebo/MAVROS stack or hardware was run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names family ros and helper RosDriver, but the confirmed entry symbol gym_px4.envs.gymPX4_env:gymPX4 (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:52) is a gym.Env subclass whose primary interface is reset()/step(action), so this package uses GymnasiumDriver and serves cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1. The ROS topics, MAVROS services and arming sequence in the constructor are upstream simulator wiring, not a ROS transport this driver exposes. The fake is an F0 analytic vertical-altitude stand-in that preserves the legacy one-tuple reset, four-tuple step and Box(0.0, 1.0, shape=(1,)) action space (action_space_ref gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:57-69). It loads no PX4, Gazebo, MAVROS, ROS or gym_px4 code; x and y stay at zero; the thrust-to-velocity gain, step size and start altitude are placeholders; and there is no wall-clock pacing. The fake returns immediately, whereas the upstream reset publishes setpoints in an unbounded loop with no timeout and the constructor waits for MAVROS services and arms the vehicle (gym_px4/envs/gymPX4_env.py:119-139, 162-190). NOT COVERED: the real sim path (gym.make('px4-v0')) was not run; it needs ROS 1 melodic, Gazebo 9, MAVROS, the legacy gym package and a running PX4 SITL, none of which exists where the gate runs or is installed by this package. No real SITL trajectory, MAVROS arming or offboard transition is claimed. The upstream observation space is a two-value Box but its description and the README's observation text are wider; the fake follows the code. The action space in code is one thrust value while README.md:57 documents four action values; the fake follows the code. The seed endpoint is accepted and recorded for the next reset but does not change the deterministic fake or the fixed desired/initial upstream reset. The package has no operator-tunable numeric input, so it declares no Limit.operator_required and no site-limits example. Warnings left by the gate and their reasons: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only buffers the seed for the next reset and makes no native call), and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for ticks, the reset seed, the seed input and action.values (the catalogue/bridge-derived simulator inputs carry no unit; thrust is a dimensionless 0..1 command). There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. License: the upstream declares no license (NOASSERTION, license_class unknown; the clone has no LICENSE file), as recorded from the card; this is not a publication clearance. The clone was read only and stays unmodified. This package is model-authored and reviewed_by stays null: no human review, hardware run or live ROS/simulator run is claimed.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the GymnasiumDriver deviation (gymPX4 is a legacy gym.Env, gymPX4_env.py:52, registered as px4-v0), action_space_ref (57-69, Box(0, 1, shape=(1,))), all 12 facts, the fake and the stop text against gymPX4_env.py, the README and PD_test.py at the pin. The deviation and the action space are right, but safe_state described only the fake, although an e-stop calls nothing upstream (close() is a no-op) and a live PX4 SITL keeps the quadcopter armed in OFFBOARD that the constructor and every reset arm; five facts said more than their lines (the reset and step facts named topics defined on 105-109, 'more than 50 consecutive steps' although success_steps is reset only by reset, 'sleeps at least 0.03 s' cited 202-203, which show only the Rate, and the constructor fact cited 119-139 for the init_env call on 114); the fake's reset accepted seed and options, which the upstream reset(self) does not, and a test asserted the fake's exact [0, 0] start observation. The reviewer rewrote safe_state and the docstring, corrected those five facts and added seven (the publishers, offb_arm ignoring both responses, the counter reset, the unbounded busy-wait in step, the sleep, the no-op close, the README's SITL MAVROS URL) and four fidelity gaps (the environment cannot tell SITL from a real vehicle, live-construction hazards and standard output, the observation leaving its own Box, the legacy reset path) in driver.py; gave the fake the upstream reset() signature (fake.py); replaced the exact start-observation assertion with the upstream exit condition (both values below 0.2) and added a legacy-signature check (test_driver.py); updated facts.md; and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate and collect.py --strict pass with the expected G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings and the digest unchanged (sha256:e0563f7d61ea8776ffd739b07e7a24fcdb94c3d62369f658b9a542654ea8f0bb); the override proposal records the gymnasium family. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Fake-only contract; no sim backend is declared. The upstream gymPX4 cannot tell PX4 SITL from a real vehicle: constructing it calls the global rospy.init_node, waits without a timeout for three MAVROS services, requests OFFBOARD and arms whatever flight controller MAVROS is connected to without checking either response, and every reset re-arms a disarmed vehicle (for example after a crash-landing disarm) while publishing a 2 m setpoint in an unbounded loop; step busy-waits until the altitude changes, and both print to standard output. An MHS e-stop calls nothing upstream and close() is a no-op, so nothing lands or disarms the vehicle; what PX4 does when the thrust setpoints stop is PX4 configuration. Only the README points MAVROS at the SITL UDP port; a serial fcu_url would let the same code fly a real quadcopter (R2 or above, human hardware review needed). The existing robots.json entry for this repository (recon wave A, family ros) must be merged by hand with this proposal. No licence file in the clone.
